sourceChecks.text: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文はミリアムとアロンがクシュ人の女性をめぐってモーセに語ったことを記す。

sourceChecks.text: The LORD spoke suddenly to Moses, to Aaron, and to Miriam, “You three come out to the Tent of Meeting!” The three of them came out.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: この節ではミリアムとアロンの言動またはその後の出来事が記される。

sourceChecks.text: The LORD came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: この節ではミリアムとアロンの言動またはその後の出来事が記される。

sourceChecks.text: The cloud departed from over the Tent; and behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. Aaron looked at Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: この節ではミリアムとアロンの言動またはその後の出来事が記される。

sourceChecks.text: Miriam was shut up outside of the camp seven days, and the people didn’t travel until Miriam was brought in again.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: この節ではミリアムとアロンの言動またはその後の出来事が記される。

sourceChecks.text: The children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month. The people stayed in Kadesh. Miriam died there, and was buried there.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ミリアムの死と埋葬が記される。

sourceChecks.text: The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. She bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 系譜の記述でミリアムがモーセとアロンの姉妹と明示される。

sourceChecks.text: Article title Miriam; profile’s first-use note should not state later sibling relation or Num 20:1.
